package rulefixtures

import "container/list"

// scenario for go_perf_layer_data_structure_choice_linked_list_for_cache_iteration: Layer: Data structure choice. Flag container/list use in cache iteration paths where slices or maps would improve locality.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: contextual.
type scenario520Cache struct {
	entries  *list.List
	capacity int
}

func scenario520NewCache(cap int) *scenario520Cache {
	return &scenario520Cache{
		entries:  list.New(),
		capacity: cap,
	}
}

func (c *scenario520Cache) Keys() []string {
	keys := make([]string, 0, c.entries.Len())
	for e := c.entries.Front(); e != nil; e = e.Next() {
		keys = append(keys, e.Value.(string))
	}
	return keys
}
